caption: The drawing depicts a single chair placed upright and viewed from the side against a plain, light beige background. The chair has four curved wooden legs and an ornate wooden backrest featuring decorative carving. The backrest and the front legs both have a brown wood tone. The seat and a small section of the lower backrest are upholstered in a textured light blue material. There is visible shading beneath the chair, suggesting a light source from above and slightly to the left. The composition is centered on the page, with ample empty space surrounding the chair. A small, hand-written inscription or signature appears to the lower right of the chair.
title: Rosewood Chair
